name: Acquia Search
description: Provides integration between your Drupal site and Acquia's hosted search service.
consumes_plugin_types: search_api Backend (@SearchApiBackend) — provides the 'acquia_search_solr' backend that talks to Acquia's hosted Solr
search_api_solr SolrConnector (@SolrConnector) — provides the 'solr_acquia_connector' connector (HMAC-authenticated Acquia Solr endpoint)
migrate destination/source — 'acquia_search_index' plugins for D7 → D8+ index migration
project_description:
Customers should upgrade to Acquia Search 3.0.9 before upgrading to 3.1.0+

 
 Back to top 

 Support guidelines 
 If you'd like to report a bug, please create a Drupal.org issue for this module. If you'd like assistance from Acquia Support, please submit a support request via the Acquia Help Center. For more information on how to submit an Acquia Support ticket, please see https://docs.acquia.com/support/tickets/ .

 Back to top 

 Supported versions 
 Acquia Search v3 
 This version lets you connect your Drupal website in the Acquia Cloud to Acquia Search with Solr 7+. The Acquia Search Solr module provides the authentication service enabling you to connect with Acquia's hosted Solr search indexes.

 The module is dependent on Search API Solr 4.2+ for Drupal 8+.

 Important: Use Composer to install the Acquia Search Solr module to ensure all dependencies are met.

 Back to top 

 Where is Acquia Search for Drupal 7? 
 Due to the lack of general composer support in Drupal 7, Acquia Search is integrated into Acquia Connector . New in 7.x-4.x : Both the Apachesolr and Search API integrations are now in the Acquia Search submodule.

 Back to top 

 Unsupported Versions 
 Acquia Search 3.0.x no longer supported with Connector 3.x going EOL

Acquia Search 2.x no longer is active due to Solr4 being EOL

Acquia Search 6.x-1.5700 is valid for Apache Solr Search Integration 6.x-1.x

Acquia Search 6.x-3.0 is valid for Apache Solr Search Integration 6.x-3.x
